messages:
Emma: Quick sync — Atlas Retail requested a performance bench for their cart-recommendation endpoint next week. Targets: sustained ~1,000 qps, p99 < 120ms. Typical input ~64 tokens, 95th up to 512. They also flagged HSM + VPC peering on the security questionnaire. Can we assemble SRE + SE + solutions to coordinate test plan, cost, and security answers?

Liam: We can run this on Dedicated. Need model variant confirmation, whether tokens are input+output, and if embeddings are part of the flow. Propose: warmup + steady-state runs, plus a longer soak to validate KV cache behavior.

Sophia: SE here — flow includes an embed call for context lookups (~10% of requests). Recommend starting with rdx-13b-q4. If they insist on higher quality, rdx-70b is possible but changes capacity math.

Jordan: From runtime: for 1k qps at worst-case 512 tokens assume ~6-8 A100/80GB equivalents to meet p99. KMS/HSM in Private adds ~2–6ms if we sign per-request. I'll draft node plan and prewarm procedure.

Morgan: I'll own security questionnaire (KMS/HSM, data-in-transit/rest, SOC2). HSM attestation needs legal & infra intake; we can provide runbook and sample MCP. Propose a short Dedicated trial with network isolation for peering demo.

Emma: Can someone post example load commands and a bench schedule? Atlas wants ramp, steady-state, and artifact delivery spelled out.

Liam: Sample load commands: 
```
vegeta attack -targets=atlas.targets.txt -rate=1000 -connections=300 -duration=5m | vegeta report -type='hist[0,50ms,100ms,200ms,500ms]'
```
Or k6: `k6 run --vus 1000 --duration 5m script.js`

Jordan: Bench plan: 
- Prewarm: 5m ramp 0->1k qps
- Steady-state: 3x 5m runs (collect token counts, KV cache hit ratio, GPU/PCIe metrics)
- Soak: optional 30m at 1k qps
- Failure test: route to fallback rdx-7b to verify graceful degradation
- Artifacts: raw logs, traces, per-token cost estimate, dashboards
I'll create a dedicated cluster reservation and configure canary fallback.

Morgan: Ballpark bench cost for sales: short run (1–2h) $2k–5k; extended soak add $5k–15k depending on hours/model. I'll post a precise per-hour burn after node counts.

Sophia: Security notes: customer-managed KMS supported; HSM-backed signing for Private deployments (attestation needs intake). Network: VPC peering and private endpoints supported; will provide templates. I'll add a skeleton answers doc once legal clears wording.

Emma: Action items: 
- @Jordan: create dedicated bench cluster and post node counts (EOD tomorrow)
- @Liam: reserve load generators and run tests Wed 10am PT
- @Morgan: finalize security questionnaire answers and bench cost range
- @Sophia: finalize prompt set and confirm embed ratio
I'll update SOW and propose Wed 10am PT to Atlas after node confirm. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: benchmark-cluster-reservation #R-2026 created by Jordan (expires in 72h)

Jordan: Note: cold-starts can spike p99 ~20–45s. Include 5m prewarm and KV priming. Continuous batching helps throughput but may add a few ms to steady tail.

Emma: Morgan — can you confirm HSM attestation timeline (legal + infra) ~2–3 weeks? Procurement needs that.

Morgan: Tentative: legal + infra intake 7–14 business days. We can provide existing SOC2 certs within 48h. HSM attestation timeline depends on their vendor; starting intake now.

Sophia: Uploaded sample prompt set and synthetic generator to shared folder: https://redwood.internal/bench/atlas-requests — use as atlas.targets.txt.

[Run day - Liam]: Run complete (Wed 10:00 PT). Summary: 3 steady runs at 1k qps on rdx-13b-q4 with Sophia's corpus. Results: p50 24ms, p95 86ms, p99 132ms (slightly over 120ms target). Error rate 0.12% (network retries). KV cache hit 38%. After aggressive cache priming follow-up, p99 reduced to 118ms. Full artifacts uploaded to runbook.

Jordan: Root cause was cache coldness and a small hotspot on one node (driver flake) — rebalanced and fixed. No infra blockers.

Morgan: Attaching encryption and HSM option proof points; will follow up with legal on attestation timeline.

Emma: I'll update Atlas with results, include cost estimate for one-time bench and Dedicated pilot options. Thanks team :rocket:
